bio: Set within a grand grade I listed building, Park House is a beautiful restaurant in Cardiff that boasts 2 AA Rosettes.  Park House features elegant interiors which provides the perfect setting to enjoy Traditional Afternoon Tea. You can enjoy a selection of speciality cut sandwiches, an array of homemade cakes and Pastries, Freshly Baked Scones, and if you're in an extra indulgent mood, why not add a glass of champagne.
